title: Share of worldwide activity inequality explained by the gender step gap

source.name: Large-scale physical activity data reveal worldwide activity inequality (Althoff et al.)

notes: The study found women walk disproportionately fewer steps than men in nearly every country studied, and this gender-activity gap is widest in the highest-obesity countries. The gender-activity gap statistically explains 43% of the observed difference in activity inequality between countries; the remaining 57% reflects other factors.

points.label: Explained by the gender step gap
